sort.en: And Smith saw that. Smith wrote about Bengal as this sort of crown jewel.
sort.zh: 斯密看到了这一点。斯密笔下的孟加拉，是那种“皇冠上的明珠”式的存在。

sort.en: But Tom is sort of the final word in what happens in that band.
sort.zh: 他们都能演奏出色的东西。他们都增加了不可思议的东西。

sort.en: But I was like, you sort of can do this forever, but maybe.
sort.zh: 但我当时想，你某种程度上可以永远这样做，但也许。

sort.en: Even now when he's sort of made his new startup is a USA, right?
sort.zh: 即使是现在，当他可以说是开启了他的新创业项目——美国（USA），对吧？

sort.en: I want to round out something on that sort of black pill side, which is...
sort.zh: 我想在那种“黑色药丸”的一面补充一点，那就是……

social.en: If we look back, major social movements often begin during periods of longterm pressure.
social.zh: 如果我们回顾过去，大型社会运动往往在长期压力的时期开始。

social.en: Amr thinks that now, because of social media, this problem, or bottleneck, is gone.
social.zh: 阿姆尔认为，现在由于有了社交媒体，这个问题或瓶颈已经消失了。

social.en: Poverty is a sign that your country, your society, has economic and social problems.
social.zh: 贫困表明你的国家、你的社会存在经济和社会问题。

social.en: They adapted to living with humans. They evolved to fit into our social world.
social.zh: 它们适应了与人类共同生活。它们进化得能够融入我们的社会世界。

social.en: Ethnicity means the social, cultural and linguistic characteristics shared by a group of people.
social.zh: “族群”（Ethnicity）意味着一群人所共享的社会、文化和语言特征。

society.en: Now, over time, as societies changed, the role of dogs began to change too.
society.zh: 随着时间的推移，社会不断变迁，狗的角色也开始发生变化。

society.en: In a surveillance society, monitoring is not limited to one place or one moment.
society.zh: 在一个监控社会中，监视并不局限于一个地方或一个时刻。

society.en: The general feeling was that, as a society, we had moved past all that.
society.zh: 普遍的看法是，作为一个社会，我们已经超越了这一切。

society.en: At exactly the same time, though, Britain was also becoming an incredibly multicultural society.
society.zh: 但与此同时，英国也正在成为一个极其多元文化的社会。

society.en: This was, by the standards of its time, a highly educated and rational society.
society.zh: 按当时的标准，这是一个高度受教育且理性的社会。

solar.en: Enough wind turbines and solar panels could deliver all the energy a country needed.
solar.zh: 只要有足够的风力发电机和太阳能电池板，就能提供一个国家所需的全部能源。

solar.en: Wind and solar are cheap, and they are quick and easy to build, relative to nuclear at least.
solar.zh: 风能和太阳能很便宜，而且建造起来又快又容易，至少相对于核能是这样。

solar.en: They are essentially remnants of the early solar system, chunks of rock and metal that never formed into planets.
solar.zh: 它们本质上是早期太阳系的残余物，是没有形成行星的岩石和金属块。

solar.en: Now, though, some science and space experts are excited about a planet in a different solar system from our own.
solar.zh: 不过现在，一些科学和太空专家对我们自己太阳系之外的一颗行星感到兴奋。

solar.en: I put $100 million into SpaceX, $80 million in Tesla, 20 in the solar city, and I had to borrow money for rent, right?
solar.zh: 我把1亿美元投给了SpaceX，8000万美元投给了特斯拉，2000万美元投给了SolarCity，结果我还得借钱付房租，对吧？

solution.en: The phrase, one-size-fits-all, describes trying to apply the same solution to many different problems.
solution.zh: “一刀切”这个短语描述的是试图将相同的解决方案应用于许多不同的问题。

solution.en: And finally, a silver bullet means a simple solution to a complicated problem.
solution.zh: 最后，silver bullet 指的是解决复杂问题的简单方案。

solution.en: The reality is that all of these solutions come with their own share of problems.
solution.zh: 现实情况是，所有这些解决方案本身都伴随着各自的问题。

solution.en: Money might go to these trendy AI projects instead of practical solutions or better technology.
solution.zh: 资金可能会流向这些赶时髦的AI项目，而不是实用的解决方案或更好的技术。

solution.en: But others say, “Well, actually, this was the best solution for Manchester at the time.”
solution.zh: 但另一些人则说：“嗯，实际上，这是当时对曼彻斯特最好的解决方案。”

soft.en: Cuneiform symbols were pressed into soft clay tablets using a stylus, like a stick.
soft.zh: 楔形文字符号是用触笔（类似于小棍子）压印在软泥板上的。

soft.en: And because it was soft, warm, and ready to eat, it could also be stolen.
soft.zh: 而且因为它又软、又热、随时可以食用，它也很容易被偷走。

soft.en: If you describe food as mushy, you mean it's soft – the opposite of crunchy.
soft.zh: 如果你把食物描述为软绵绵的，你是说它很软——与酥脆相反。

soft.en: How about you? I bought a soft drink on the way to work this morning.
soft.zh: 你呢？我今天早上上班路上买了一瓶软饮料。

soft.en: Plushie is short for plush toy – a toy doll or animal stuffed with a soft cloth filling.
soft.zh: Plushie是plush toy（毛绒玩具）的简称——一种填充有柔软布料填料的玩偶或动物玩具。

soul.en: He saw an asteroid that he named 16 Psyche, after the Greek goddess of the soul.
soul.zh: 他发现了一颗小行星，并以希腊神话中灵魂女神的名字将其命名为 16 Psyche（灵神星）。

soul.en: If something touches your soul, it affects you deeply on an emotional or spiritual level.
soul.zh: 如果某事触动了你的灵魂，它会在情感或精神层面上深刻地影响你。

soul.en: I stare. Sometimes if you go to an open mic night, people can really touch your soul with what they're saying.
soul.zh: 我凝视着。有时候如果你去开放麦之夜，人们所说的话真的能触动你的灵魂。

soul.en: Or failing that, you might post it in a forum somewhere and wait, hoping for a kind soul to put you out of your misery.
soul.zh: 或者如果不行，你可能会把它发到某个论坛上等待，希望有好心人能把你从痛苦中解救出来。

soul.en: These massive structures were impressive and elaborate tombs, designed to protect the Pharaohs ‘, the Egyptian king’s, bodies and help their soul travel to the afterlife.
soul.zh: 这些宏伟的建筑是令人惊叹且复杂的陵墓，旨在保护法老（埃及国王）的遗体并帮助他们的灵魂前往来世。

solve.en: Different countries, different members of the EU, disagreed with how to solve the problems.
solve.zh: 不同的国家、欧盟不同的成员国，对于如何解决问题有着不同的意见。

solve.en: The DRC’s extraordinary mineral wealth, has made its problems far more difficult to solve.
solve.zh: 刚果（金）非凡的矿产财富使其问题变得更加难以解决。

solve.en: And some economists believe degrowth would actually make it harder to solve the climate crisis.
solve.zh: 一些经济学家还认为，“减增长”实际上会使解决气候危机变得更加困难。

solve.en: Teachers quickly noticed that he could solve problems without using traditional methods.
solve.zh: 老师们很快注意到他不用传统方法就能解题。

solve.en: But there has been significant investment and progress in solving this issue.
solve.zh: 但在解决这一问题上已经有了重大的投资和进展。

somehow.en: But one person, a woman named Elizabeth Johnson Jr., was somehow missed out.
somehow.zh: 但有一个人，一个名叫小伊丽莎白·约翰逊（Elizabeth Johnson Jr.）的妇女，却不知为何被遗漏了。

somehow.en: But in maths class he came alive. Numbers somehow made sense when people did not.
somehow.zh: 但在数学课上，他整个人都生动了起来。当人们让人难以理解时，数字不知怎么地总是讲得通。

somehow.en: But somehow, somewhere, you've been accused and charged with a crime.
somehow.zh: 但不知怎的，在某个地方，你还是被指控并被起诉犯了罪。

somehow.en: And what you get is an object that is somehow more beautiful than before it was broken.
somehow.zh: 于是你得到的是一个比破碎前更优美的物体。

somehow.en: What if it's not that poor people are somehow deficient but that poverty makes everyone less capable?
somehow.zh: 如果不是穷人在某种程度上有所欠缺，而是贫穷让每个人都变得能力不足呢？

solo.en: It is, in fact, Russia. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt, starting with solo – something done alone.
solo.zh: 事实上，是俄罗斯。好的。让我们复习一下我们学过的词汇，首先是“solo”——独自完成的事情。

solo.en: Artistic swimming routines are performed solo, meaning by just one person, or as a duet, which means by two people.
solo.zh: 花样游泳的成套动作有单人表演（solo），即只有一个人，也有双人表演（duet），即由两个人完成。

solo.en: How similar or different from what, like if you're working with an artist today how different is what you're doing with that artist today compared to what you did with LL four decades ago probably not so different it's it's probably pretty similar just it it depends on the artist like because LL was a solo rap artist and he didn't have a band or make music I was responsible for making the the tracks and my version of that was a very stripped down minimal thing but now i get to work with bands sometimes that have a big sound and there are a lot of players and i'm looking for the essence of each of these artists and the essence tends to be stripped down but it's stripped down to what they are just finished a new album with the strokes and they're a band of five people so it sounds like a band of five people doesn't sound less than that.
solo.zh: 我在播客里听你提过几次。

solo.en: And so like, in that way, it's acceptance, but of like your, your idea of who I am that you hate so much i accept it i can live with that even though like we don't want to think what if i am it i don't believe that but i can do that and i can end the conversation so i'm taking improv classes at the moment because i'm doing my first live shows in the uk and island oh so this live talk uh thank you yeah uh everything's uh no solo stood on stage for 90 minutes comedy no just oh okay lessons yeah insights and stuff probably some shit that i've learned today uh anyway we released it and every show sold out and then got venue upgraded and then sold out again in less than 45 minutes across all of the dates which was great but then scary because i now had to speak to like three times as many people per night for additional nights on top of what i thought anyway i'm doing improv in improv there is one rule and the rule is don't punk the game so uh we're doing some exercise where we need to make silly noises as we pass this imaginary energy around and i need to go like boing and send it back and you need to go whoosh and pass it on and all this sort of shit the one thing that you're not allowed to do is not make one of the noises that's allowed yeah and i really think about punking the game an awful lot and you see it happen in podcasts you see it happen on tv you see it happen and it can be both destructive and constructive, but it's always destructive to the people that are trying to play the game.
solo.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，这是一种接受，接受你对我那种充满恨意的看法。我接受它，我可以忍受，尽管我们不想去想“万一我是呢”，我不相信那是真的，但我可以那样做，我可以结束对话。

sour.en: He could turn your cow’s milk sour or make your children fall ill and die.
sour.zh: 他能让你家母牛的奶变酸，或者让你的孩子生病夭折。

sour.en: That's fundamental. It's sour grapes at an existential level, right?
sour.zh: 这很根本。这是一种存在主义层面的吃不到葡萄说葡萄酸，对吧？

sour.en: Yeah. Related to the sort of cynicism thing that we were talking about earlier, and I call it the cynicism safety blanket, that sour grapes at an existential level.
sour.zh: 是的。这与我们之前谈论的那种愤世嫉俗有关，我称之为“愤世嫉俗的安全毯”，那是存在主义层面的“酸葡萄”。

sour.en: But people's taste is unique to them. What tastes sweet to me, might taste sour or salty to someone else, and this is because of differences in the receptors we're born with.
sour.zh: 但每个人的味觉都是独一无二的。我觉得甜的东西，在别人尝来可能是酸的或咸的，这是因为我们天生的味觉受体存在差异。

sour.en: Definitely the tortilla chip. Why? Because you could do so many things – dip it in almost everything, adding some guacamole,spicy salsa or just sour cream with a mixture of chipotle sauce.
sour.zh: 绝对是玉米片。为什么？因为你可以做很多尝试——几乎可以蘸任何东西，加点牛油果酱（guacamole）、辣萨尔萨酱，或者只是酸奶油混合烟熏辣椒酱。

soup.en: And, Phil, I have a question for you about Wattana Panich' s 50-year-old soup.
soup.zh: 而且，Phil，我有一个关于 Wattana Panich 50年老汤的问题要问你。

soup.en: A 50-year-old soup might not be to everyone's taste, but forever foods are surprisingly common.
soup.zh: 一锅50年的汤可能不合所有人的胃口，但“永久食物”却出奇地普遍。

soup.en: For example, I made some soup the other day and I was a bit heavy-handed with the salt – it tasted disgusting!
soup.zh: 例如，我前几天做了一些汤，结果盐放得有点重——尝起来太难以下咽了！

soup.en: We use it a lot and so from stocks to soups – and in vegetable dishes, meat dishes – there's very certain a clove of garlic in somewhere.
soup.zh: 我们经常使用它，从高汤到汤羹——还有蔬菜菜肴、肉类菜肴——到处都能肯定找到一瓣大蒜的身影。

soil.en: Ole’s liquid clay involves manipulating soil – using and controlling it skilfully to achieve some result.
soil.zh: 奥莱的液态粘土涉及对土壤的操纵——巧妙地使用和控制它以达到某种结果。

soil.en: As a result, soil quality did decline and food became harder to produce.
soil.zh: 结果，土壤质量确实下降了，粮食也变得更难生产。

soil.en: Every year, the Nile flooded and left behind good soil for farming.
soil.zh: 每年，尼罗河都会泛滥并留下肥沃的土壤用于农业。

soil.en: Everyone knows that plants need sunlight and water to grow, but soil is just as important.
soil.zh: 众所周知，植物生长需要阳光和水，但土壤同样重要。

soil.en: Jains don't eat garlic because uprooting the plant kills both it and the soil ecosystem it grows in.
soil.zh: 耆那教徒不吃大蒜，因为连根拔起植物既会杀死植物，也会破坏它生长的土壤生态系统。

sorrow.en: The tradition is that you call your family and friends and apologise for any sorrows you've caused.
sorrow.zh: 这个传统的做法是给你的家人和朋友打电话，为你造成的任何痛苦道歉。

sorrow.en: Sorrows are sources of sadness or regret.
sorrow.zh: 痛苦（sorrows）是悲伤或遗憾的来源。

source.en: Bandura described four different sources of self-efficacy, four ways you can build your self-efficacy.
source.zh: 班杜拉描述了自我效能的四个不同来源，即你可以建立自我效能的四种方式。

source.en: And in return, they provided the animals with a steady source of protein.
source.zh: 作为回报，人类为这些动物提供了稳定的蛋白质来源。

source.en: And when that trust collapses, people look for different sources of information.
source.zh: 当这种信任崩塌时，人们就会寻找不同的信息来源。

source.en: And this mattered enormously. Because livestock meant a reliable source of food.
source.zh: 这极其重要。因为牲畜意味着可靠的食物来源。

source.en: For example, she discovered that radium could constantly produce heat even without an external energy source.
source.zh: 例如，她发现镭甚至在没有外部能源的情况下也能持续产生热量。

soy.en: Yet we're told formula, you know, made with soy and corn syrup, which was invented recently, is somehow better than cow milk.
soy.zh: 然而我们被告知，用大豆和玉米糖浆制成的配方奶——那是最近才发明的——竟然比牛奶更好。

soy.en: Instead, people are getting their daily amount of protein through plant-based alternatives – meat-free sausages and burgers made using ingredients like soy, tofu or fungi, as well as tempeh, beans or nuts.
soy.zh: 相反，人们通过植物性替代品来获取每日所需的蛋白质——用大豆、豆腐、真菌以及豆豉、豆类或坚果等成分做成的无肉香肠和汉堡。

solitary.en: Others were put into solitary confinement —a tiny, dark closet that could barely fit one person.
solitary.zh: 还有的人被关进单人禁闭室——一个几乎只能容下一个人的狭小黑暗小隔间。

solitary.en: The guards singled them out for extra punishment, like longer periods in solitary confinement or forcing them to do degrading tasks.
solitary.zh: 狱警对这些人格外惩罚，比如延长单独禁闭的时间，或逼他们做有辱人格的事情。

solitary.en: Now as we know, pandas are notoriously reluctant to mate: the female pandas have a narrow window of fertility, they're solitary creatures and it takes two to tango when it comes to reproduction.
solitary.zh: 众所周知，大熊猫向来不愿意交配：雌性大熊猫的受孕期很短，它们是独居动物，而且在繁殖这件事上需要双方共同努力。

solitary.en: He was transferred to the Supermax prison in Florence, Colorado, where he lived out the remainder of his days, much of it in solitary confinement, before finally killing himself in June of 2023, at the age of 81.
solitary.zh: 他被转移到科罗拉多州佛罗伦萨的超级最高安全监狱（Supermax），在那里度过了余生，其中大部分时间都在单人牢房中度过，直到最后在 2023 年 6 月自杀身亡，享年 81 岁。

solitary.en: Yeah, a hotel room, a bathtub, tub you know a hot tub but it's always like a such a solitary like ending for somebody that and then the whole world cries for them and with them it's like oh i can't believe this what what do you oh this is so and i'm like yeah because you'll be shocked at how lonely being well known can actually be because it means you can never be alone in many places and that's where i think core friends are very important you said in there that you what they don't know is that you're a human and that you're going through life in all the same ways as everyone else yeah well no not in the same ways but in different ways and i think that's that's the you know i i do talk about awareness yeah i'm very careful i you know i and maybe it's because of how i was raised as well very careful to not make it like a woe is me thing i'm not like fame has hurt me and it's harmed me and you know there are many things that have come with it every gift is a curse, you know?
solitary.zh: 是的，酒店房间，浴缸，你知道，热水浴缸，但对于某人来说，这总是一个非常孤独的结局，然后全世界都为他们哭泣，和他们一起哭，就像，哦，我不敢相信，这，这太……而我会说，是的，因为你会震惊于出名实际上有多孤独，因为这意味着你在很多地方永远无法独处，这就是我认为核心朋友非常重要的原因。你在里面说，他们不知道的是你是一个人，你正在经历和每个人一样的生活。是的，嗯，不，不是以同样的方式，而是以不同的方式，我认为这就是，你知道，我确实谈论过意识。是的，我非常小心，你知道，我，也许是因为我的成长方式，非常小心，不让它变成一种“我好可怜”的事情。我不是说名声伤害了我，你知道，它确实带来了一些东西，每一份礼物都是诅咒，你知道吗？

sore.en: But first, Georgie, a question. We all know the common cold – now, that’s the illness that makes you cough and sneeze, have a sore throat and headache.
sore.zh: 但首先，Georgie，有个问题。我们都知道普通感冒——也就是那种让你咳嗽、打喷嚏、喉咙痛和头疼的疾病。

sore.en: A sore head in the morning, perhaps a slap on the wrist from a police officer for doing something more serious, but nothing that will forever change the trajectory of your life.
sore.zh: 顶多是第二天早上头疼，或者因为做了更出格的事挨警察训一顿，但不会有什么能彻底改变你人生轨迹的事。

southeast.en: Polynesians were a group of seafaring people whose ancestors originally came from Southeast Asia.
southeast.zh: 波利尼西亚人是一群航海民族，他们的祖先最初来自东南亚。

southeast.en: There are so many more examples. Chinese immigrants, in particular, transformed the food of Southeast Asia.
southeast.zh: 还有很多这样的例子。尤其是中国移民，改变了东南亚的食物。

southeast.en: By the beginning of the 19th century, European powers were becoming interested in Southeast Asia, too.
southeast.zh: 到了19世纪初，欧洲列强也开始对东南亚产生兴趣。

southeast.en: This is something you find in South Asia, in the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
southeast.zh: 这是你在南亚、中东和东南亚才能发现的特点。

southeast.en: Easter Island, is in the Southeast Pacific Ocean, far from anywhere else.
southeast.zh: 复活节岛位于东南太平洋，远离其他任何地方。

software.en: On Tesla versus Waymo, would you bet on software or hardware for self-driving?
software.zh: 关于Tesla对比Waymo，你会押注软件还是硬件进行自动驾驶？

software.en: And this software analyzed all the loans in all the pools that Mike bought and then sold.
software.zh: 这个软件分析了 Mike 买入并随后卖出的所有池子里的所有贷款。

software.en: It’s a completely new way of building software, and it’s changing who gets to call themselves a “coder”.
software.zh: 这是一种全新的软件开发方式，也正在改变谁有资格自称是“程序员”。

software.en: And the software, the data, didn't seem worried at all.
software.zh: 而软件和数据看起来一点也不让人担心。

software.en: And finally, vibe coding, which is using AI tools to build software, and it was this that was the winner.
software.zh: 最后是 vibe coding，指的是用 AI 工具来开发软件，而最终胜出、成为年度词汇的正是这一个。

sofa.en: You know what? I think it's just relaxing on my sofa, in my living room.
sofa.zh: 你知道吗？我觉得就是在客厅的沙发上放松一下。

sofa.en: Brilliant. So Christopher Hitchens, one of the new atheists, was sat in some British pub with Douglas Murray when Douglas is young and you know you can imagine it's some musty Chesterfield sofa he's probably got a cigarette in his mouth and a glass of scotch or something and uh Douglas is vacillating between these two different choices that he needs to make and he is um complaining lamenting the fact that I have this thing but I have this thing and if I do this thing I can't do this thing and and what what do i do and apparently hitch like sat back and douglas in life we must choose our regrets and i was like fuck so i'm three manhattans deep in douglas murray's apartment in manhattan at two in the morning and he sneaks off to the toilet and i quickly write this down because i know that my like half cut alcohol brain isn't going to remember it so i've noted down.
sofa.zh: 太精彩了。克里斯托弗·希钦斯，新无神论者之一，有一次在一家英国酒吧里，和年轻时的道格拉斯·穆雷坐在一起，你可以想象那是一个发霉的切斯特菲尔德沙发，他嘴里可能叼着一支烟，手里端着一杯苏格兰威士忌什么的，然后啊，道格拉斯正在他需要做出的两个不同选择之间举棋不定，他正在，呃，抱怨、哀叹着说：我既有这个机会，又有那个机会，如果我选了这个，就没法选那个，然后，我到底该怎么办啊？据说希钦往后一靠，说道：“道格拉斯，在生活中，我们必须选择我们的遗憾。”我当时想：我靠！当时我在曼哈顿道格拉斯·穆雷的公寓里，已经喝了三杯曼哈顿鸡尾酒，时间是凌晨两点，他悄悄溜去洗手间，我赶紧把这话记下来，因为我知道我那半醉的酒精大脑根本记不住，所以我把它记了下来。

soap.en: …I know my mom's perfume, my dad’s preferred soap.
soap.zh: ……我知道我妈妈的香水味，我爸爸最喜欢的肥皂味。

soap.en: Burton Elementary's a really old school, and just drinking fountains that didn't work, and the bathrooms that didn't have soap.
soap.zh: Burton Elementary是一所非常老旧的学校，饮水机不能用，洗手间里没有肥皂。

soap.en: We've never had a TV show, except maybe like one soap opera, But we never had TV shows that run for 10 seasons or 20 seasons.
soap.zh: 我们从来没有过电视节目，除了可能像一部肥皂剧，但我们从来没有过运行10季或20季的电视节目。

soap.en: Egypt is hot! A burning desert sun, long, sweaty days, and—like everywhere else in the ancient world—no soap, no deodorant, and no running water.
soap.zh: 埃及天气炎热！火辣的沙漠太阳、漫长而汗流浃背的日子，而且——就像古代世界的其他地方一样——没有肥皂、没有除臭剂，也没有自来水。

soap.en: Today we live in a world where most people have showers in their houses, soap is cheap, deodorant is everywhere, and there really is no valid reason to not wash yourself regularly.
soap.zh: 今天我们生活在一个大多数人家里都有淋浴、肥皂很便宜、除臭剂随处可见的世界里，不经常洗澡确实没有什么合理的理由。

soak.en: It was a slaughter. The Romans were soaked, shivering, and unorganised.
soak.zh: 这是一场屠杀。罗马人浑身湿透、瑟瑟发抖且毫无阵型。

soak.en: Wow! Who knew so much was going on inside babies’ sponge-like brains as they soak up the sounds they hear?
soak.zh: 哇！谁知道当宝宝们吸收他们听到的声音时，他们海绵般的大脑里发生了这么多事情？

soak.en: It might be watching a movie. It might be taking a soak in the tub and reading a book or being in my art room and painting whatever comes to me.
soak.zh: 可能是看电影。可能是泡个澡读本书，或者待在艺术室里画任何涌上心头的东西。

soak.en: When she sailed to meet Mark Antony, so the legend goes, she had the sails of her boat soaked in perfume so that long before he saw her, he could smell her.
soak.zh: 传说她乘船去见马克·安东尼（Mark Antony）时，让人把船帆浸泡在香水里，这样远在他看到她之前，就能闻到她的气味。

southern.en: Then there were the Gauls, the recently conquered or allied tribes from southern France.
southern.zh: 还有高卢人，也就是刚刚被征服或归附的法国南部部落。

southern.en: It probably started somewhere close to southern Wales, and then went east and north.
southern.zh: 它大概始于威尔士南部附近的某个地方，然后向东、向北延伸。

southern.en: It concerned the workhouse in the market town of Andover, in southern England.
southern.zh: 它关乎英格兰南部集镇安多弗（Andover）的济贫院。

southern.en: Srinivasa Ramanujan was born in 1887 in a small town in Southern India.
southern.zh: Srinivasa Ramanujan于1887年出生于印度南部的一个小镇。

southern.en: The First Nations include hundreds of different nations spread across southern Canada.
southern.zh: 第一民族包括分布在加拿大南部的数百个不同的族群。

somewhat.en: At the same time, Easter Island has experienced somewhat of a cultural revival.
somewhat.zh: 与此同时，复活节岛也经历了一定程度的文化复兴。

somewhat.en: As you might know, the acronym DOGE is somewhat of a joke.
somewhat.zh: 正如你可能知道的那样，DOGE 这个缩写多少有点开玩笑的意味。

somewhat.en: And in fact, the idea of this being “new” or “on the rise” is also somewhat problematic.
somewhat.zh: 事实上，这种认为这是“新鲜事物”或“正在崛起”的观点也有点问题。

somewhat.en: The real version was somewhat different, as we’ll come to discover.
somewhat.zh: 而真实的版本却有所不同，这一点我们接下来就会发现。

somewhat.en: It wasn’t a privileged upbringing by any means, but the young boy was clever, confident, and somewhat rebellious.
somewhat.zh: 他的成长环境绝对谈不上优越，但这个小男孩聪明、自信，而且有点叛逆。

soften.en: And euphemisms can also be used to manipulate you, mislead you, or soften reality.
soften.zh: 但委婉语也可以用来操纵你、误导你或粉饰现实。

soften.en: I still do that now. I think they've softened to it.
soften.zh: 我现在还是那样做。我想他们已经软化了。

soften.en: Unlike euphemisms, dysphemisms do not seek to soften the harshness of the subject, but rather to emphasize the harshness.
soften.zh: 与委婉语不同，反委婉语并不试图缓和主题的严厉性，而是去强调这种严厉性。

soften.en: Tough fibres soften. And cooked food releases anywhere between 30 and 100 percent more calories than the same food eaten raw.
soften.zh: 坚韧的纤维变软了。而且煮熟的食物释放的热量比生吃同样的食物多出 30% 到 100%。

soften.en: Northern journalists knew that they needed to adjust their accent, to soften it to sound less Northern, in order to get ahead in their careers.
soften.zh: 北方记者心知肚明，他们必须调整自己的口音，将其弱化以显得不那么“北方”，这样才能在职业生涯中出人头地。

sometime.en: But sometime in his late teens, slowly but surely, he started to make his move.
sometime.zh: 但在他快成年的时候，慢慢地、坚定地，他开始采取行动了。

sometime.en: But sometime during Trump’s first term, he changed his tune.
sometime.zh: 但在特朗普第一个任期的某个时候，他改变了调门。

sometime.en: But to come back to where we started. Sometime around a million years ago, our early ancestors found fire in the wild and kept it burning.
sometime.zh: 但让我们回到我们开始的地方。大约在一百万年前，我们的早期祖先在野外发现了火并让它持续燃烧。

sometime.en: Most political commentators believed that he would call an election sometime in the autumn, after there was the chance for some more positive news about the economy, but he didn’t wait.
sometime.zh: 大多数政治评论员认为他会在秋季的某个时候举行大选，因为那时可能会有一些关于经济的更积极的消息，但他没有等。

sometime.en: He kept that fact a secret for 20 years because Jehovah's Witnesses believe that sometime in the near future, when Jehovah God cleanses the earth and remakes it into the paradise that it once was, those who have not faithfully obeyed his word will be destroyed.
sometime.zh: 他把这个事实保守了20年，因为耶和华见证人相信，在不久的将来，当耶和华上帝洁净地球并将其重新创造为昔日的乐园时，那些没有忠实顺从他话语的人将被毁灭。

southwest.en: He was born in 1929, in a small village in the Gironde, in southwest France.
southwest.zh: 他于1929年出生在法国西南部吉伦特省的一个小村庄。

southwest.en: In the newspapers of the Southwest, he had been reported as a murderer: a man who had used his badge to pursue a private vendetta and then fled justice.
southwest.zh: 在美国西南部的报纸上，他曾被报道成一个杀人凶手：一个借警徽之名追求私人复仇、事后又逃避法律制裁的人。

socialist.en: Venezuela, of course, is a socialist country, and they had really ambitious public spending programs.
socialist.zh: 当然，委内瑞拉是一个社会主义国家，他们有雄心勃勃的公共开支项目。

socialist.en: Among its members is a more radical faction, led by a socialist named Ali Soilih.
socialist.zh: 在其成员中，有一个由名叫 Ali Soilih 的社会主义者领导的更为激进的派系。

socialist.en: Those big apartment blocks and socialist architecture designed to symbolize communist power and communist modernization.
socialist.zh: 那些大型公寓楼和社会主义建筑旨在象征共产主义的力量与现代化。

socialist.en: But on the other side, there were massive socialist buildings.
socialist.zh: 另一方面，这里耸立着庞大的社会主义建筑。

socialist.en: Orwell’s readers might claim to support liberal, even socialist policies, but quietly they were physically repulsed by the lives of the people these policies were meant to help.
socialist.zh: 奥威尔的读者或许会声称自己支持自由主义甚至是社会主义政策，但私下里，他们对这些政策本想帮助的人的生活感到生理上的排斥。

sophisticated.en: Countries such as France and Italy have really developed reputations as great sophisticated cuisines.
sophisticated.zh: 法国和意大利等国确实树立了精致美味料理的声誉。

sophisticated.en: Suddenly, there was a sophisticated body of knowledge just waiting to be studied.
sophisticated.zh: 突然之间，出现了一套复杂的知识体系正等待着人们去研究。

sophisticated.en: There is a common idea that while other countries have sophisticated culinary traditions, Britain somehow missed out.
sophisticated.zh: 人们普遍认为，虽然其他国家有着精致的烹饪传统，但英国不知怎么地错过了。

sophisticated.en: When it became clear that this was the work of a sophisticated terrorist, the FBI launched what would become the longest and most expensive manhunt in its history.
sophisticated.zh: 当明显这是一起由高智商恐怖分子制造的案件时，FBI 发起了其历史上历时最长、耗资最大的一场大搜捕。

sophisticated.en: Kaczynski had encrypted them using an incredibly sophisticated system of codes, but fortunately for the authorities, the ciphers, the codes to decipher the system, were also found in the cabin.
sophisticated.zh: 卡钦斯基用一套极其复杂的密码系统对它们进行了加密，但幸运的是，解密这些系统的密码本也在木屋里被找到了。

soar.en: Inflation soared, debt piled up, and the state became little more than an empty shell.
soar.zh: 通货膨胀飙升，债务堆积如山，国家沦空壳一个。

soar.en: If your rate wasn’t fixed, your monthly payments soared.
soar.zh: 如果你的利率不是固定的，你的月供就会猛增。

soar.en: Later, unemployment soared during the Great Depression.
soar.zh: 后来，在大萧条时期，失业率飙升。

soar.en: And in the 19th century, especially the late 19th century, when the world’s population was growing rapidly and there was so much new technology revolutionizing farming, the global demand for phosphate soared.
soar.zh: 在 19 世纪，特别是 19 世纪后期，当时世界人口迅速增长，有如此多的新技术彻底改变了农业，全球对磷酸盐的需求猛增。

sovereign.en: Norway created a sovereign wealth fund. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund.
sovereign.zh: 挪威创建了一个主权财富基金。主权财富基金是政府拥有的投资基金。

sovereign.en: Norway created a sovereign wealth fund. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund.
sovereign.zh: 挪威创建了一个主权财富基金。主权财富基金是政府拥有的投资基金。

sovereign.en: By then, Australia was fully sovereign. It was fully able to make decisions entirely for itself.
sovereign.zh: 到那时，澳大利亚已经完全主权独立。它完全有能力完全为自己做决定。

sovereign.en: Sovereign as they may be, but sometimes they still need the...
sovereign.zh: 尽管他们很独立，但有时他们仍然需要……

sovereign.en: Canada is completely sovereign. But they have a king, and that king happens to also be the King of England.
sovereign.zh: 加拿大是完全主权独立的。但他们有一位国王，而这位国王恰好也是英国的国王。

sociology.en: He wound up transferring to Columbia University, where he took a sociology course with a professor named Sudhir Venkatesh.
sociology.zh: 他最终转学到哥伦比亚大学，在那里他上了一门由苏迪尔·文卡特什（Sudhir Venkatesh）教授的社会学课程。

sociology.en: But it was logically set out, touched on political theory, sociology, psychology, and history, and it displayed a truly encyclopedic knowledge.
sociology.zh: 但它逻辑清晰，触及了政治理论、社会学、心理学和历史，并展现了堪称百科全书般的广博知识。

solid.en: He has a CDO whose top tranche is rated AAA, rock solid, good as money.
solid.zh: 他搞出了一个CDO，其最顶层的分档评级为AAA，稳如磐石，跟钱一样硬挺。

solid.en: This situation is similar to the dot-com companies that had huge hype but no solid revenue.
solid.zh: 这种情况类似于那些炒作巨大却没有稳定收入的网络公司。

solid.en: Startups or even larger companies that rely on this hype rather than solid business models probably will go bankrupt.
solid.zh: 依赖这种炒作而不是扎实商业模型的初创公司甚至规模更大的公司可能会破产。

solid.en: They gave Hannibal a solid, reliable core.
solid.zh: 他们为Hannibal提供了坚实可靠的中坚力量。

solid.en: Politicians lie without consequence, misinformation spreads faster than facts, and many people seem to trust their feelings more than solid evidence.
solid.zh: 政客们撒谎不用承担后果，虚假信息的传播速度比事实更快，而且许多人似乎更相信自己的直觉，而不是确凿的证据。

solidarity.en: Soldiers and demonstrators mingled, and some soldiers even showed solidarity with the people.
solidarity.zh: 士兵和示威者混在一起，一些士兵甚至对人民表现出了声援。

solidarity.en: Additionally, the war in Ukraine has tested Europe’s security and Europe’s solidarity.
solidarity.zh: 此外，乌克兰战争也考验了欧洲的安全和欧洲的团结。

solidarity.en: One of the most important developments was the rise of the Solidarity movement in the 1980s.
solidarity.zh: 其中最重要的发展之一便是 20 世纪 80 年代“团结工会”运动的兴起。

solidarity.en: The migration crisis of the 2010s, raised questions about borders and solidarity.
solidarity.zh: 2010年代的难民危机引发了对边界和团结的质疑。

solidarity.en: This was a psychological tactic. It created jealousy and mistrust among the prisoners, breaking down any sense of solidarity they might have had.
solidarity.zh: 这是一种心理战术，在囚犯之间制造了嫉妒和猜忌，瓦解了他们本可能拥有的团结感。

sober.en: He's not sober. Why is this happening? Many children experience this.
sober.zh: 他没清醒。为什么会发生这种情况？许多孩子经历过这种情况。

sober.en: You know, I would know by the sounds of the footsteps whether or not my stepfather was sober or drunk.
sober.zh: 你知道，我通过脚步声就能知道我的继父是清醒还是喝醉了。

sober.en: The sober Putin, on the other hand, presented himself as a calm, no-nonsense figure—a man who could bring order to the chaos.
sober.zh: 与此形成鲜明对比的是，滴酒不沾的普京把自己塑造成了一个冷静、务实的形象——一个能为混乱带来秩序的人。

sober.en: And then like, rather than not looking at the knife or trying to take painkillers to not feel the pain, it's like completely sobering up, taking the knife and twisting it in your own heart and being like, I'm going to fucking do something about this.
sober.zh: 与其不去正视那把刀，或者试图通过吃止痛药来麻痹痛苦，不如彻底清醒过来，拿起那把刀，亲手刺进自己的心脏，然后对自己说：我一定要为此做点什么。

softly.en: One key technique he used was Sfumato, which is a method of softly blending colors and tones so that there are no sharp lines.
softly.zh: 他使用的关键技术之一是晕涂法（Sfumato），这是一种柔和地融合颜色和色调、使画面没有生硬线条的方法。

socialism.en: The whole struggle between Socialism and Capitalism is made out to be a very hard problem.
socialism.zh: 社会主义与资本主义之间的整场论战，都被渲染成了一个极为棘手的问题。

solvable.en: And that is solvable. And so whenever I feel sad now, it's been my trigger to immediately think, What do I not know?
solvable.zh: 而这是可以解决的。所以每当我感到悲伤时，它就成了我的触发点，让我立刻去想：我不知道什么？

soccer.en: I try to talk my kids into quitting soccer, baseball if they’re not good at it.
soccer.zh: 我试图劝说我的孩子们放弃足球、棒球，如果他们不擅长的话。

soda.en: And when I say culture, I’m not just talking about free soda in the break room and casual Fridays, as I discovered on the company tour with Zappos Supervisor Loren Becker.
soda.zh: 当我谈到文化时，我指的不仅仅是休息室里的免费苏打水和休闲星期五，正如我在与 Zappos 主管 Loren Becker 一起参观公司时发现的那样。

sole.en: And we have got to find a way to become his sole provider of bonds, of mortgage bonds, to fill his appetite.
sole.zh: 而我们必须想方设法成为他唯一的债券供应商，供应抵押贷款债券，以满足他的胃口。
